```{r, echo=FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
#let's check if any duplicate is left:
sum(duplicated(dt))

# check for NAs:
any(is.na(dt))
colSums(is.na(dt))

# get rid of observations in class 8:
dt <- dt[!label=="8", ]

#convert class to numeric:
dt$label <- as.numeric(dt$label)

# create data partition and declare training and test sets:
idx <- createDataPartition(dt[,label], p = 0.8, list = F, times = 1)
training <- dt[idx]
test <- dt[!idx]

library(dplyr)

min_n <- training %>%
  group_by(label) %>%
  summarise(n = n()) %>%
  pull(n) %>%
  min()

# Downsampling a min_n per ciascuna classe
set.seed(42)
training_bal <- training %>%
  group_by(label) %>%
  slice_sample(n = min_n) %>%
  ungroup()

# create training_x, training_y, test_x, test_y:
train_x <- training[,!"label"]
train_y <- training[,label]
test_x  <- test[,!"label"]
test_y  <- test[,label]

# check if data is balanced across classes:
prop.table(table(training$label))

#check scale of the data:
summary(dt)
str(dt)
head(dt)

#they're on different scale, so we need to scale it:
#scale and get statistics to use on the test set to apply the same scaling
train_x_scaled <- scale(train_x)
means <- attr(train_x_scaled, "scaled:center")
sds <- attr(train_x_scaled, "scaled:scale")

# scale test too:
test_x_scaled <- scale(test_x, center = means, scale = sds)

# re-add class to sets:
train_final <- cbind(train_x_scaled, Class = training$label)
test_final  <- cbind(test_x_scaled,  Class = test$label)

train_final <- as.data.frame(train_final)
test_final <- as.data.frame(test_final)

# check scale again:
summary(train_final)
summary(test_final)

```


```{r, echo=FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
# --- split train / validation (stratificato, dal training set) ---
set.seed(32)
val_idx <- createDataPartition(train_y, p = 0.2, list = FALSE)[, 1]

x_tr_sub  <- train_x_scaled[-val_idx, ]
y_tr_sub  <- train_y[-val_idx]
x_val_sub <- train_x_scaled[val_idx, ]
y_val_sub <- train_y[val_idx]

# convert to tensors
x_train_tensor <- torch_tensor(x_tr_sub, dtype = torch_float())
y_train_tensor <- torch_tensor(y_tr_sub, dtype = torch_long())

x_val_tensor <- torch_tensor(x_val_sub, dtype = torch_float())
y_val_tensor <- torch_tensor(y_val_sub, dtype = torch_long())

x_test_tensor <- torch_tensor(test_x_scaled, dtype = torch_float())
y_test_tensor <- torch_tensor(test_y, dtype = torch_long())

# skeleton:
model <- nn_sequential(
    nn_linear(97, 130), nn_relu(),
    nn_linear(130, 16), nn_relu(),
    nn_linear(16, 5)
)

weights <- torch_tensor(c(1, 1, 1, 1, 1))
criterion <- nn_cross_entropy_loss(weight = weights)
optimizer <- optim_adam(model$parameters, lr = 0.001)

# early stopping settings (criterio: val accuracy)
epochs <- 2500          # massimo
patience <- 300         # epoche senza miglioramento della val accuracy prima di fermarsi
best_val_acc <- 0
best_epoch <- 0
best_state <- NULL

for (i in 1:epochs) {
    # --- training step ---
    model$train()
    optimizer$zero_grad()
    y_pred_tensor <- model(x_train_tensor)
    loss <- criterion(y_pred_tensor, y_train_tensor)
    loss$backward()
    optimizer$step()

    # --- validation ---
    model$eval()
    with_no_grad({
        val_pred <- model(x_val_tensor)
        val_loss <- criterion(val_pred, y_val_tensor)$item()
        val_acc  <- (val_pred$argmax(dim = 2) == y_val_tensor)$sum()$item() / y_val_tensor$size()
    })

    # salva il modello migliore in base alla val accuracy
    if (val_acc > best_val_acc) {
        best_val_acc <- val_acc
        best_epoch <- i
        best_state <- lapply(model$state_dict(), function(x) x$clone())
    }

    if (i %% 10 == 0) {
        winners <- y_pred_tensor$argmax(dim = 2)
        train_acc <- (winners == y_train_tensor)$sum()$item() / y_train_tensor$size()
        cat("Epoch:", i,
            "| Train loss", round(loss$item(), 4), "acc", round(train_acc, 4),
            "| Val loss", round(val_loss, 4), "acc", round(val_acc, 4), "\n")
    }

    # stop se non migliora da 'patience' epoche
    if (i - best_epoch >= patience) {
        cat("Early stopping at epoch", i, "- best epoch:", best_epoch,
            "- best val acc:", round(best_val_acc, 4), "\n")
        break
    }
}

# ripristina i pesi della migliore epoca
model$load_state_dict(best_state)

# Check on the test set
model$eval()
y_pred_tensor <- model(x_test_tensor)
y_pred <- as.array(y_pred_tensor$argmax(dim = 2))

cat(" Accuracy: ", sum(y_pred == test_y) / length(y_pred), "\n")

confusionMatrix(
  as.factor(y_pred),
  as.factor(test_y)
)
```


```{r}
library(torch)
library(caret)  # per createFolds e confusionMatrix
library(dplyr)

# Parameters
k <- 10
epochs <- 2500
lr <- 0.004

# to save metrics for each fold
accuracies <- numeric(k)

folds <- createFolds(train_y, k = k, list = TRUE)

for (i in 1:k) {
  cat("\n--- Fold", i, "---\n")
  
  # Indexes
  test_idx <- folds[[i]]
  train_idx <- setdiff(seq_len(nrow(train_x)), test_idx)
  
  # Split train/test for this fold 
  x_train_fold <- train_x[train_idx, ]
  y_train_fold <- train_y[train_idx]
  
  x_val_fold <- train_x[test_idx, ]
  y_val_fold <- train_y[test_idx]
  
  # calculate mean and std on training fold
  means <- colMeans(x_train_fold)
  sds <- apply(x_train_fold, 2, sd)
  
  # Scale train and validation fold using metrics from training set
  x_train_fold_scaled <- scale(x_train_fold, center = means, scale = sds)
  x_val_fold_scaled <- scale(x_val_fold, center = means, scale = sds)
  
  # Convert into tensors
  x_train_tensor <- torch_tensor(x_train_fold_scaled, dtype = torch_float())
  y_train_tensor <- torch_tensor(y_train_fold, dtype = torch_long())
  
  x_val_tensor <- torch_tensor(x_val_fold_scaled, dtype = torch_float())
  y_val_tensor <- torch_tensor(y_val_fold, dtype = torch_long())
  
  # Model
  model <- nn_sequential(
    nn_linear(97, 130), nn_relu(),
    nn_linear(130, 16), nn_relu(),
    nn_linear(16, 5), nn_softmax(dim = 2)
  )
  
  criterion <- nn_cross_entropy_loss()
  optimizer <- optim_adam(model$parameters, lr = lr)
  
  # Training loop
  for (epoch in 1:epochs) {
    model$train()
    optimizer$zero_grad()
    
    y_pred <- model(x_train_tensor)
    loss <- criterion(y_pred, y_train_tensor)
    
    loss$backward()
    optimizer$step()
    
    if (epoch %% 500 == 0) {
      cat("Epoch:", epoch, "Loss:", loss$item(), "\n")
    }
  }
  
  # Evaluation
  model$eval()
  y_pred_val <- model(x_val_tensor)
  pred_labels <- y_pred_val$argmax(dim = 2)
  
  # compute accuracy
  accuracy <- sum(as_array(pred_labels) == y_val_fold) / length(y_val_fold)
  accuracies[i] <- accuracy
  cat("Fold", i, "Accuracy:", accuracy, "\n")
  
  # Confusion matrix 
  true <- factor(y_val_fold, levels = 1:5)
  pred <- factor(as_array(pred_labels), levels = 1:5)
  cm <- confusionMatrix(pred, true)
  print(cm)
}

# Final Results
cat("\n--- Risultato Finale ---\n")
cat("Accuratezza media:", mean(accuracies), "\n")
cat("Deviazione standard:", sd(accuracies), "\n")


```

```{r}
library(data.table)

# XGBoost model:
xgbtraining <- train_final
setDT(xgbtraining)

# Escludiamo la colonna Class usando la sintassi data.table corretta
xgbtraining_x <- as.matrix(xgbtraining[, !"Class"])

# MODIFICA 1: Convertiamo le 5 classi in numeri da 0 a 4
target_levels <- levels(as.factor(xgbtraining$Class)) # Memorizza l'ordine ufficiale delle classi
xgbtraining_y <- as.integer(as.factor(xgbtraining$Class)) - 1

# training:
# MODIFICA 2: Cambiato objective in "multi:softprob" e aggiunto num_class = 5
xgb <- xgboost(data = xgbtraining_x, label = xgbtraining_y, nrounds = 500, 
               objective = "multi:softprob", num_class = 5)

# XGBoost Test Set:
xgbtest <- test_final
setDT(xgbtest) # Assicuriamoci che sia un data.table come il training

xgbtest_x <- as.matrix(xgbtest[, !"Class"])

# MODIFICA 3: Convertiamo il test set usando gli stessi identici livelli del training
xgbtest_y <- as.integer(factor(xgbtest$Class, levels = target_levels)) - 1

# xgboost predictions:
# mypred sarà una matrice con 5 colonne (una probabilità per classe)
mypred <- predict(xgb, newdata = xgbtest_x)
mypred_matrix <- matrix(mypred, ncol = 5, byrow = TRUE)

# MODIFICA 4: Prende l'indice della colonna con probabilità massima (da 1..5 a 0..4)
pred_class <- max.col(mypred_matrix) - 1

# MODIFICA 5: Adattiamo i fattori per la matrice di confusione (livelli da 0 a 4)
# Rimosso il parametro 'positive = "1"' perché non è più una classificazione binaria
pred_factor <- factor(pred_class, levels = c(0, 1, 2, 3, 4))
true_factor <- factor(xgbtest_y, levels = c(0, 1, 2, 3, 4))

# 3. Calcola la matrice di confusione multiclasse
cm <- confusionMatrix(pred_factor, true_factor, mode = "prec_recall")
print(cm)
```

```{r}
# ---------- NUOVO: FNN con early stopping (funzioni riutilizzabili) ----------
# Stessa logica del blocco FNN con early stopping:
# architettura 130-16, logit in uscita (niente softmax), lr 0.001, max 2500 epoche,
# validation stratificata 20% presa dal training, criterio = val accuracy, patience 300.
library(torch)
library(caret)

fnn_es_fit <- function(x_train_scaled, y_train_f, n_classes,
                       lr = 0.001, epochs = 2500, patience = 300,
                       val_p = 0.2, seed = 32, log_every = 0, verbose = TRUE) {
  set.seed(seed)
  torch_manual_seed(seed)

  # split train / validation (stratificato per classe)
  val_idx <- createDataPartition(y_train_f, p = val_p, list = FALSE)[, 1]

  x_tr_t  <- torch_tensor(x_train_scaled[-val_idx, , drop = FALSE], dtype = torch_float())
  y_tr_t  <- torch_tensor(as.integer(y_train_f)[-val_idx], dtype = torch_long())
  x_val_t <- torch_tensor(x_train_scaled[val_idx, , drop = FALSE], dtype = torch_float())
  y_val_t <- torch_tensor(as.integer(y_train_f)[val_idx], dtype = torch_long())

  model <- nn_sequential(
    nn_linear(ncol(x_train_scaled), 130), nn_relu(),
    nn_linear(130, 16), nn_relu(),
    nn_linear(16, n_classes)
  )
  criterion <- nn_cross_entropy_loss()
  optimizer <- optim_adam(model$parameters, lr = lr)

  best_val_acc <- 0
  best_epoch <- 0
  best_state <- NULL
  stopped_at <- epochs

  for (i in 1:epochs) {
    # --- training step ---
    model$train()
    optimizer$zero_grad()
    y_pred_tensor <- model(x_tr_t)
    loss <- criterion(y_pred_tensor, y_tr_t)
    loss$backward()
    optimizer$step()

    # --- validation ---
    model$eval()
    with_no_grad({
      val_pred <- model(x_val_t)
      val_loss <- criterion(val_pred, y_val_t)$item()
      val_acc  <- (val_pred$argmax(dim = 2) == y_val_t)$sum()$item() / y_val_t$size()
    })

    # salva il modello migliore in base alla val accuracy
    if (val_acc > best_val_acc) {
      best_val_acc <- val_acc
      best_epoch <- i
      best_state <- lapply(model$state_dict(), function(x) x$clone())
    }

    if (log_every > 0 && i %% log_every == 0) {
      train_acc <- (y_pred_tensor$argmax(dim = 2) == y_tr_t)$sum()$item() / y_tr_t$size()
      cat("Epoch:", i,
          "| Train loss", round(loss$item(), 4), "acc", round(train_acc, 4),
          "| Val loss", round(val_loss, 4), "acc", round(val_acc, 4), "\n")
    }

    # stop se non migliora da 'patience' epoche
    if (i - best_epoch >= patience) {
      stopped_at <- i
      break
    }
  }

  if (verbose) {
    cat("Early stopping at epoch", stopped_at, "- best epoch:", best_epoch,
        "- best val acc:", round(best_val_acc, 4), "\n")
  }

  # ripristina i pesi della migliore epoca
  if (!is.null(best_state)) model$load_state_dict(best_state)
  model$eval()

  list(model = model, best_epoch = best_epoch, stopped_at = stopped_at,
       best_val_acc = best_val_acc)
}

fnn_es_predict <- function(model, x_scaled, lv) {
  model$eval()
  with_no_grad({
    out <- model(torch_tensor(x_scaled, dtype = torch_float()))
  })
  factor(lv[as_array(out$argmax(dim = 2))], levels = lv)
}
```

```{r}
library(torch)
library(caret)
library(dplyr)
library(e1071)
library(class)
library(ranger)
library(xgboost)

# ---------- Setup ----------
# dt deve contenere: colonne feature (feat_0, feat_1, ...), "label", "subject_id"
# Adatta i nomi se necessario
dt <- as.data.frame(dt)
feature_cols <- setdiff(colnames(dt), c("label", "subject_id"))

dt$label <- as.factor(dt$label)
dt$subject_id <- as.factor(dt$subject_id)

subjects <- unique(dt$subject_id)

epochs_nn <- 1800
lr <- 0.004
knn_k <- 7

results_loso <- data.frame(
  subject = character(),
  model = character(),
  accuracy = numeric(),
  training_time_sec = numeric(),
  n_train_epochs = integer(),
  n_test_epochs = integer(),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

confusion_matrices_loso <- list()

# ---------- SVM (radial) in parallelo sui soggetti ----------
# Stesso modello e stessi parametri di prima (C-classification, kernel radiale, scale = FALSE),
# stesso scaling calcolato sul training di ogni soggetto. Un fit per soggetto, uno per processo.
# Nota: il tempo registrato e' il tempo del fit nel worker (con piu' processi attivi
# insieme puo' essere un po' piu' alto di un fit da solo).
library(parallel)

n_workers <- max(1, min(length(subjects), detectCores() - 1))
cat("SVM radiale in parallelo su", n_workers, "worker\n")

X_all <- as.matrix(dt[, feature_cols])
y_all <- dt$label
subj_all <- as.character(dt$subject_id)
lv_all <- levels(dt$label)

svm_radial_one <- function(subj) {
  test_mask <- subj_all == subj

  x_tr <- X_all[!test_mask, , drop = FALSE]
  x_te <- X_all[test_mask, , drop = FALSE]
  y_tr <- factor(y_all[!test_mask], levels = lv_all)
  y_te <- factor(y_all[test_mask], levels = lv_all)

  means <- colMeans(x_tr)
  sds <- apply(x_tr, 2, sd)
  sds[sds == 0] <- 1e-8

  x_tr_s <- scale(x_tr, center = means, scale = sds)
  x_te_s <- scale(x_te, center = means, scale = sds)

  svm_train_df <- data.frame(x_tr_s)
  svm_train_df$Class <- y_tr
  svm_val_df <- data.frame(x_te_s)

  t0 <- Sys.time()
  m <- e1071::svm(Class ~ ., data = svm_train_df, type = "C-classification",
                  kernel = "radial", scale = FALSE)
  tt <- as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), t0, units = "secs"))

  pred <- factor(predict(m, svm_val_df), levels = lv_all)

  list(subject = subj, pred = pred, truth = y_te, time = tt,
       n_train = nrow(x_tr), n_test = nrow(x_te))
}

cl <- makeCluster(n_workers)
tryCatch({
  clusterEvalQ(cl, library(e1071))
  clusterExport(cl, c("X_all", "y_all", "subj_all", "lv_all", "svm_radial_one"))
  svm_radial_res <- parLapplyLB(cl, as.character(subjects), svm_radial_one)
}, finally = stopCluster(cl))

for (r in svm_radial_res) {
  acc_svm_radial <- sum(r$pred == r$truth) / length(r$truth)
  cm_svm_radial <- tryCatch(confusionMatrix(r$pred, r$truth), error = function(e) NULL)

  results_loso <- rbind(results_loso, data.frame(
    subject = r$subject, model = "SVM_radial", accuracy = acc_svm_radial,
    training_time_sec = r$time,
    n_train_epochs = r$n_train, n_test_epochs = r$n_test
  ))
  confusion_matrices_loso[[paste0("SVM_radial_subj", r$subject)]] <- cm_svm_radial
  cat("SVM (radial) soggetto", r$subject, "Accuracy:", acc_svm_radial,
      "| Training time:", round(r$time, 2), "s\n")
}

# ---------- LOSO loop ----------
for (subj in subjects) {

  cat("\n=========== Left-out subject:", as.character(subj), "===========\n")

  test_mask <- dt$subject_id == subj
  train_mask <- !test_mask

  x_train_fold <- as.matrix(dt[train_mask, feature_cols])
  y_train_fold <- dt$label[train_mask]

  x_val_fold <- as.matrix(dt[test_mask, feature_cols])
  y_val_fold <- dt$label[test_mask]

  cat("Train epochs:", nrow(x_train_fold), "| Test epochs:", nrow(x_val_fold), "\n")

  means <- colMeans(x_train_fold)
  sds <- apply(x_train_fold, 2, sd)
  sds[sds == 0] <- 1e-8

  x_train_fold_scaled <- scale(x_train_fold, center = means, scale = sds)
  x_val_fold_scaled <- scale(x_val_fold, center = means, scale = sds)

  y_train_fold_f <- factor(y_train_fold, levels = levels(dt$label))
  y_val_fold_f <- factor(y_val_fold, levels = levels(dt$label))
  n_classes <- length(levels(dt$label))
  n_features <- ncol(x_train_fold_scaled)

  # ---------- FNN (early stopping su val accuracy, come nel blocco FNN) ----------
  cat("\n--- FNN ---\n")
  t0 <- Sys.time()

  fnn_fit <- fnn_es_fit(x_train_fold_scaled, y_train_fold_f, n_classes)

  training_time_fnn <- as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), t0, units = "secs"))

  pred_fnn <- fnn_es_predict(fnn_fit$model, x_val_fold_scaled, levels(dt$label))

  acc_fnn <- sum(pred_fnn == y_val_fold_f) / length(y_val_fold_f)
  cm_fnn <- tryCatch(confusionMatrix(pred_fnn, y_val_fold_f), error = function(e) NULL)

  results_loso <- rbind(results_loso, data.frame(
    subject = as.character(subj), model = "FNN", accuracy = acc_fnn,
    training_time_sec = training_time_fnn,
    n_train_epochs = nrow(x_train_fold), n_test_epochs = nrow(x_val_fold)
  ))
  confusion_matrices_loso[[paste0("FNN_subj", subj)]] <- cm_fnn
  cat("FNN Accuracy:", acc_fnn, "| Training time:", round(training_time_fnn, 2), "s\n")

  # ---------- XGBoost ----------
  cat("\n--- XGBoost ---\n")
  t0 <- Sys.time()

  xgb_train_y <- as.integer(y_train_fold_f) - 1

  xgb_model <- xgboost(data = x_train_fold_scaled, label = xgb_train_y, nrounds = 500,
                        objective = "multi:softprob", num_class = n_classes, verbose = 0)

  training_time_xgb <- as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), t0, units = "secs"))

  xgb_pred_raw <- predict(xgb_model, newdata = x_val_fold_scaled)
  xgb_pred_matrix <- matrix(xgb_pred_raw, ncol = n_classes, byrow = TRUE)
  pred_xgb <- factor(levels(dt$label)[max.col(xgb_pred_matrix)], levels = levels(dt$label))

  acc_xgb <- sum(pred_xgb == y_val_fold_f) / length(y_val_fold_f)
  cm_xgb <- tryCatch(confusionMatrix(pred_xgb, y_val_fold_f), error = function(e) NULL)

  results_loso <- rbind(results_loso, data.frame(
    subject = as.character(subj), model = "XGBoost", accuracy = acc_xgb,
    training_time_sec = training_time_xgb,
    n_train_epochs = nrow(x_train_fold), n_test_epochs = nrow(x_val_fold)
  ))
  confusion_matrices_loso[[paste0("XGBoost_subj", subj)]] <- cm_xgb
  cat("XGBoost Accuracy:", acc_xgb, "| Training time:", round(training_time_xgb, 2), "s\n")

  # ---------- Random Forest ----------
  cat("\n--- Random Forest ---\n")
  t0 <- Sys.time()

  rf_model <- ranger(x = x_train_fold_scaled, y = y_train_fold_f)

  training_time_rf <- as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), t0, units = "secs"))

  rf_pred <- predict(rf_model, data = x_val_fold_scaled)
  pred_rf <- factor(rf_pred$predictions, levels = levels(dt$label))

  acc_rf <- sum(pred_rf == y_val_fold_f) / length(y_val_fold_f)
  cm_rf <- tryCatch(confusionMatrix(pred_rf, y_val_fold_f), error = function(e) NULL)

  results_loso <- rbind(results_loso, data.frame(
    subject = as.character(subj), model = "RandomForest", accuracy = acc_rf,
    training_time_sec = training_time_rf,
    n_train_epochs = nrow(x_train_fold), n_test_epochs = nrow(x_val_fold)
  ))
  confusion_matrices_loso[[paste0("RandomForest_subj", subj)]] <- cm_rf
  cat("Random Forest Accuracy:", acc_rf, "| Training time:", round(training_time_rf, 2), "s\n")

  # ---------- KNN ----------
  cat("\n--- KNN ---\n")
  t0 <- Sys.time()

  pred_knn_raw <- knn(train = x_train_fold_scaled, test = x_val_fold_scaled,
                       cl = y_train_fold_f, k = knn_k)

  training_time_knn <- as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), t0, units = "secs"))

  pred_knn <- factor(pred_knn_raw, levels = levels(dt$label))
  acc_knn <- sum(pred_knn == y_val_fold_f) / length(y_val_fold_f)
  cm_knn <- tryCatch(confusionMatrix(pred_knn, y_val_fold_f), error = function(e) NULL)

  results_loso <- rbind(results_loso, data.frame(
    subject = as.character(subj), model = "KNN", accuracy = acc_knn,
    training_time_sec = training_time_knn,
    n_train_epochs = nrow(x_train_fold), n_test_epochs = nrow(x_val_fold)
  ))
  confusion_matrices_loso[[paste0("KNN_subj", subj)]] <- cm_knn
  cat("KNN Accuracy:", acc_knn, "| Time (predict, lazy learner):", round(training_time_knn, 2), "s\n")

  # SVM radiale: calcolato in parallelo prima del loop (vedi sopra)
  # SVM lineare: tolto dalla LOSO
}

# ---------- Riepilogo finale ----------
summary_loso <- results_loso %>%
  group_by(model) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_accuracy = mean(accuracy),
    sd_accuracy = sd(accuracy),
    mean_training_time_sec = mean(training_time_sec),
    sd_training_time_sec = sd(training_time_sec)
  )

print(summary_loso)
```

```{r}
library(parallel)
library(e1071)
library(caret)

n_workers <- max(1, min(length(subjects), detectCores() - 1))
cat("SVM lineare in parallelo su", n_workers, "worker\n")

X_all <- as.matrix(dt[, feature_cols])
y_all <- dt$label
subj_all <- as.character(dt$subject_id)
lv_all <- levels(dt$label)

svm_linear_one <- function(subj) {
  test_mask <- subj_all == subj
  x_tr <- X_all[!test_mask, , drop = FALSE]
  x_te <- X_all[test_mask, , drop = FALSE]
  y_tr <- factor(y_all[!test_mask], levels = lv_all)
  y_te <- factor(y_all[test_mask], levels = lv_all)

  means <- colMeans(x_tr)
  sds <- apply(x_tr, 2, sd)
  sds[sds == 0] <- 1e-8
  x_tr_s <- scale(x_tr, center = means, scale = sds)
  x_te_s <- scale(x_te, center = means, scale = sds)

  svm_train_df <- data.frame(x_tr_s); svm_train_df$Class <- y_tr
  svm_val_df <- data.frame(x_te_s)

  t0 <- Sys.time()
  m <- e1071::svm(Class ~ ., data = svm_train_df, type = "C-classification",
                  kernel = "linear", scale = FALSE)
  tt <- as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), t0, units = "secs"))

  list(subject = subj, pred = factor(predict(m, svm_val_df), levels = lv_all),
       truth = y_te, time = tt, n_train = nrow(x_tr), n_test = nrow(x_te))
}

cl <- makeCluster(n_workers)
tryCatch({
  clusterEvalQ(cl, library(e1071))
  clusterExport(cl, c("X_all", "y_all", "subj_all", "lv_all", "svm_linear_one"))
  svm_linear_res <- parLapplyLB(cl, as.character(subjects), svm_linear_one)
}, finally = stopCluster(cl))

for (r in svm_linear_res) {
  acc <- sum(r$pred == r$truth) / length(r$truth)
  results_loso <- rbind(results_loso, data.frame(
    subject = r$subject, model = "SVM_linear", accuracy = acc,
    training_time_sec = r$time, n_train_epochs = r$n_train, n_test_epochs = r$n_test))
  confusion_matrices_loso[[paste0("SVM_linear_subj", r$subject)]] <-
    tryCatch(confusionMatrix(r$pred, r$truth), error = function(e) NULL)
  cat("SVM_linear soggetto", r$subject, "Accuracy:", acc, "| Training time:", round(r$time, 2), "s\n")
}

saveRDS(list(results_loso = results_loso, cms = confusion_matrices_loso), "loso_results.rds")
```

```{r}
# ---------- NUOVO: helper comuni a pooled 10-fold e within-subject 10-fold ----------
# Stessi modelli e stessi iperparametri del blocco LOSO:
# FNN (early stopping), XGBoost (500 round), RF (default), KNN (k = 7),
# SVM radiale e lineare (scale = FALSE). Lo scaling e' ricalcolato sul training di ogni fold.
library(torch)
library(caret)
library(dplyr)
library(e1071)
library(class)
library(ranger)
library(xgboost)

# dati (stessa preparazione del blocco LOSO)
dt_cv <- as.data.frame(dt)
feature_cols_cv <- setdiff(colnames(dt_cv), c("label", "subject_id"))
dt_cv$label <- droplevels(as.factor(dt_cv$label))
dt_cv$subject_id <- as.character(dt_cv$subject_id)

X_cv <- as.matrix(dt_cv[, feature_cols_cv])
y_cv <- dt_cv$label
lv_cv <- levels(y_cv)
subjects_cv <- unique(dt_cv$subject_id)

K_CV <- 10

# fit + predizioni di tutti i modelli su un fold
run_all_models <- function(x_tr, y_tr, x_te, lv, seed = 32, with_svm = TRUE) {
  n_classes <- length(lv)
  y_tr <- factor(y_tr, levels = lv)

  means <- colMeans(x_tr)
  sds <- apply(x_tr, 2, sd)
  sds[is.na(sds) | sds == 0] <- 1e-8
  x_tr_s <- scale(x_tr, center = means, scale = sds)
  x_te_s <- scale(x_te, center = means, scale = sds)

  na_pred <- factor(rep(NA_character_, nrow(x_te)), levels = lv)
  safe <- function(expr, name) {
    tryCatch(expr, error = function(e) {
      message("  [", name, "] errore: ", conditionMessage(e))
      NULL
    })
  }

  preds <- list()
  times <- c()
  fnn_best_epoch <- NA_real_

  # FNN
  t0 <- Sys.time()
  fit <- safe(fnn_es_fit(x_tr_s, y_tr, n_classes, seed = seed, verbose = FALSE), "FNN")
  times["FNN"] <- as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), t0, units = "secs"))
  if (is.null(fit)) {
    preds[["FNN"]] <- na_pred
  } else {
    fnn_best_epoch <- fit$best_epoch
    preds[["FNN"]] <- fnn_es_predict(fit$model, x_te_s, lv)
  }

  # XGBoost
  t0 <- Sys.time()
  m <- safe(xgboost(data = x_tr_s, label = as.integer(y_tr) - 1, nrounds = 500,
                    objective = "multi:softprob", num_class = n_classes, verbose = 0), "XGBoost")
  times["XGBoost"] <- as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), t0, units = "secs"))
  if (is.null(m)) {
    preds[["XGBoost"]] <- na_pred
  } else {
    pm <- matrix(predict(m, newdata = x_te_s), ncol = n_classes, byrow = TRUE)
    preds[["XGBoost"]] <- factor(lv[max.col(pm)], levels = lv)
  }

  # Random Forest
  t0 <- Sys.time()
  m <- safe(ranger(x = x_tr_s, y = y_tr), "RandomForest")
  times["RandomForest"] <- as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), t0, units = "secs"))
  preds[["RandomForest"]] <- if (is.null(m)) na_pred else
    factor(predict(m, data = x_te_s)$predictions, levels = lv)

  # KNN (tempo = predizione, e' un lazy learner)
  t0 <- Sys.time()
  p <- safe(class::knn(train = x_tr_s, test = x_te_s, cl = y_tr, k = 7), "KNN")
  times["KNN"] <- as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), t0, units = "secs"))
  preds[["KNN"]] <- if (is.null(p)) na_pred else factor(p, levels = lv)

  # SVM: con with_svm = FALSE vengono saltati qui e calcolati in parallelo da run_svm_parallel()
  if (with_svm) {
    # SVM radiale
    t0 <- Sys.time()
    m <- safe(svm(x = x_tr_s, y = y_tr, type = "C-classification", kernel = "radial", scale = FALSE), "SVM_radial")
    times["SVM_radial"] <- as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), t0, units = "secs"))
    preds[["SVM_radial"]] <- if (is.null(m)) na_pred else factor(predict(m, x_te_s), levels = lv)

    # SVM lineare
    t0 <- Sys.time()
    m <- safe(svm(x = x_tr_s, y = y_tr, type = "C-classification", kernel = "linear", scale = FALSE), "SVM_linear")
    times["SVM_linear"] <- as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), t0, units = "secs"))
    preds[["SVM_linear"]] <- if (is.null(m)) na_pred else factor(predict(m, x_te_s), levels = lv)
  }

  list(pred = preds, time = times, fnn_best_epoch = fnn_best_epoch)
}

# risultati di un fold -> data.frame (una riga per modello)
make_rows <- function(res, y_te, cv, subject, fold, n_tr) {
  mods <- names(res$pred)
  data.frame(
    cv = cv, subject = subject, fold = fold, model = mods,
    accuracy = vapply(res$pred, function(p) mean(p == y_te), numeric(1)),
    training_time_sec = unname(res$time[mods]),
    n_train = n_tr, n_test = length(y_te),
    fnn_best_epoch = ifelse(mods == "FNN", res$fnn_best_epoch, NA_real_),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE, row.names = NULL
  )
}

# predizioni di un fold -> data.frame lungo (per le matrici di confusione)
make_preds <- function(res, y_te, cv, subject, fold) {
  do.call(rbind, lapply(names(res$pred), function(m) {
    data.frame(cv = cv, subject = subject, fold = fold, model = m,
               truth = y_te, pred = res$pred[[m]], stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  }))
}

# ---------- SVM (radiale + lineare) in parallelo sui fold ----------
# Stesso modello e stessi parametri di run_all_models (C-classification, scale = FALSE),
# scaling sul training del fold. Un task = un fold, che fa sia radiale che lineare.
# Nota: i tempi registrati sono quelli dei fit nel worker (con piu' processi attivi
# insieme possono essere un po' piu' alti di un fit da solo).
library(parallel)

svm_fold_task <- function(task) {
  x_tr <- X_cv[task$tr, , drop = FALSE]
  x_te <- X_cv[task$te, , drop = FALSE]
  y_tr <- factor(y_cv[task$tr], levels = lv_cv)

  means <- colMeans(x_tr)
  sds <- apply(x_tr, 2, sd)
  sds[is.na(sds) | sds == 0] <- 1e-8
  x_tr_s <- scale(x_tr, center = means, scale = sds)
  x_te_s <- scale(x_te, center = means, scale = sds)

  na_pred <- factor(rep(NA_character_, nrow(x_te)), levels = lv_cv)
  preds <- list()
  times <- c()
  for (kern in c("radial", "linear")) {
    nm <- paste0("SVM_", kern)
    t0 <- Sys.time()
    m <- tryCatch(
      e1071::svm(x = x_tr_s, y = y_tr, type = "C-classification", kernel = kern, scale = FALSE),
      error = function(e) NULL)
    times[nm] <- as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), t0, units = "secs"))
    preds[[nm]] <- if (is.null(m)) na_pred else factor(predict(m, x_te_s), levels = lv_cv)
  }

  list(cv = task$cv, subject = task$subject, fold = task$fold, te = task$te,
       n_tr = length(task$tr),
       res = list(pred = preds, time = times, fnn_best_epoch = NA_real_))
}

run_svm_parallel <- function(tasks, n_workers = max(1, min(length(tasks), detectCores() - 1))) {
  cat("SVM (radiale + lineare) in parallelo:", length(tasks), "fold su", n_workers, "worker\n")
  cl <- makeCluster(n_workers)
  on.exit(stopCluster(cl), add = TRUE)
  clusterEvalQ(cl, library(e1071))
  clusterExport(cl, c("X_cv", "y_cv", "lv_cv", "svm_fold_task"))
  parLapplyLB(cl, tasks, svm_fold_task)
}
```

```{r}
# ---------- NUOVO: POOLED 10-FOLD CV (tutti i soggetti insieme, fold stratificati per classe) ----------
set.seed(123)
folds_pooled <- createFolds(y_cv, k = K_CV, list = TRUE)

pooled_rows <- list()
pooled_preds <- list()

# SVM (radiale + lineare) in parallelo sui 10 fold, prima del loop
svm_tasks_pooled <- lapply(seq_along(folds_pooled), function(f) {
  te <- folds_pooled[[f]]
  list(cv = "Pooled 10-fold", subject = NA_character_, fold = f,
       te = te, tr = setdiff(seq_len(nrow(X_cv)), te))
})
svm_res_pooled <- run_svm_parallel(svm_tasks_pooled)
for (o in svm_res_pooled) {
  key <- paste0("svm_", o$fold)
  pooled_rows[[key]] <- make_rows(o$res, y_cv[o$te], o$cv, o$subject, o$fold, o$n_tr)
  pooled_preds[[key]] <- make_preds(o$res, y_cv[o$te], o$cv, o$subject, o$fold)
  cat("Fold", o$fold, "|", paste(sprintf("%s %.4f", names(o$res$pred),
      vapply(o$res$pred, function(p) mean(p == y_cv[o$te]), numeric(1))), collapse = " | "), "\n")
}

for (f in seq_along(folds_pooled)) {
  cat("\n=========== Pooled 10-fold | fold", f, "di", K_CV, "===========\n")

  te <- folds_pooled[[f]]
  tr <- setdiff(seq_len(nrow(X_cv)), te)

  res <- run_all_models(X_cv[tr, , drop = FALSE], y_cv[tr], X_cv[te, , drop = FALSE],
                        lv_cv, seed = 32 + f, with_svm = FALSE)

  rows <- make_rows(res, y_cv[te], "Pooled 10-fold", NA_character_, f, length(tr))
  pooled_rows[[paste0("fold_", f)]] <- rows
  pooled_preds[[paste0("fold_", f)]] <- make_preds(res, y_cv[te], "Pooled 10-fold", NA_character_, f)

  cat(paste(sprintf("%s %.4f", rows$model, rows$accuracy), collapse = " | "), "\n")
  cat("FNN best epoch:", res$fnn_best_epoch, "\n")

  saveRDS(list(rows = bind_rows(pooled_rows), preds = bind_rows(pooled_preds)),
          "pooled_cv_results.rds")
}

pooled_res <- bind_rows(pooled_rows)
pooled_pred_df <- bind_rows(pooled_preds)

pooled_res %>%
  group_by(model) %>%
  summarise(mean_accuracy = mean(accuracy, na.rm = TRUE),
            sd_accuracy = sd(accuracy, na.rm = TRUE),
            mean_training_time_sec = mean(training_time_sec, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  print()
```

```{r}
# ---------- NUOVO: WITHIN-SUBJECT 10-FOLD CV (un 10-fold per ogni soggetto, tutti i soggetti) ----------
# Per ogni soggetto: 10 fold stratificati sulle sue epoch, train e test sempre dello stesso soggetto.
within_rows <- list()
within_preds <- list()

# fold di ogni soggetto (stessi seed di prima), come indici globali delle righe
folds_within <- list()
for (s in seq_along(subjects_cv)) {
  subj <- subjects_cv[s]
  idx_s <- which(dt_cv$subject_id == subj)
  set.seed(1000 + s)
  folds_s <- suppressWarnings(createFolds(y_cv[idx_s], k = K_CV, list = TRUE))
  folds_within[[subj]] <- lapply(folds_s, function(i) idx_s[i])
}

# SVM (radiale + lineare) in parallelo su tutti i (soggetto, fold), prima del loop
svm_tasks_within <- list()
for (subj in subjects_cv) {
  idx_s <- which(dt_cv$subject_id == subj)
  for (f in seq_along(folds_within[[subj]])) {
    te <- folds_within[[subj]][[f]]
    if (length(te) == 0) next
    svm_tasks_within[[length(svm_tasks_within) + 1]] <- list(
      cv = "Within-subject 10-fold", subject = subj, fold = f,
      te = te, tr = setdiff(idx_s, te))
  }
}
svm_res_within <- run_svm_parallel(svm_tasks_within)
for (o in svm_res_within) {
  key <- paste(o$subject, o$fold, "svm", sep = "_")
  within_rows[[key]] <- make_rows(o$res, y_cv[o$te], o$cv, o$subject, o$fold, o$n_tr)
  within_preds[[key]] <- make_preds(o$res, y_cv[o$te], o$cv, o$subject, o$fold)
}

for (s in seq_along(subjects_cv)) {
  subj <- subjects_cv[s]
  cat("\n=========== Within-subject | soggetto", subj, "(", s, "di", length(subjects_cv), ") ===========\n")

  idx_s <- which(dt_cv$subject_id == subj)

  for (f in seq_along(folds_within[[subj]])) {
    te <- folds_within[[subj]][[f]]
    if (length(te) == 0) next

    tr <- setdiff(idx_s, te)

    res <- run_all_models(X_cv[tr, , drop = FALSE], y_cv[tr], X_cv[te, , drop = FALSE],
                          lv_cv, seed = 32 + f, with_svm = FALSE)

    key <- paste(subj, f, sep = "_")
    within_rows[[key]] <- make_rows(res, y_cv[te], "Within-subject 10-fold", subj, f, length(tr))
    within_preds[[key]] <- make_preds(res, y_cv[te], "Within-subject 10-fold", subj, f)
  }

  tmp <- bind_rows(within_rows) %>% filter(subject == subj) %>%
    group_by(model) %>% summarise(acc = mean(accuracy, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
  cat(paste(sprintf("%s %.4f", tmp$model, tmp$acc), collapse = " | "), "\n")

  # salvataggio dopo ogni soggetto, cosi' se si interrompe non si perde tutto
  saveRDS(list(rows = bind_rows(within_rows), preds = bind_rows(within_preds)),
          "within_subject_cv_results.rds")
}

within_res <- bind_rows(within_rows)
within_pred_df <- bind_rows(within_preds)

within_res %>%
  group_by(model) %>%
  summarise(mean_accuracy = mean(accuracy, na.rm = TRUE),
            sd_accuracy = sd(accuracy, na.rm = TRUE),
            mean_training_time_sec = mean(training_time_sec, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  print()
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(caret)

# soggetti da escludere dai calcoli (es. c("71")); lascia c() vuoto per tenerli tutti
exclude_subjects <- c()

model_levels <- c("FNN", "XGBoost", "RandomForest", "KNN", "SVM_radial", "SVM_linear")

# kappa e F1 macro (media sulle classi presenti) da predizioni e verita'
metrics_from_pred <- function(pred, truth, lv = lv_cv) {
  ok <- !is.na(pred)
  if (!any(ok)) return(data.frame(kappa = NA_real_, macro_f1 = NA_real_))
  cm <- confusionMatrix(factor(pred[ok],  levels = lv),
                        factor(truth[ok], levels = lv))
  data.frame(kappa = unname(cm$overall["Kappa"]),
             macro_f1 = mean(cm$byClass[, "F1"], na.rm = TRUE))
}

# --- LOSO: una riga per (modello, soggetto), dalle confusion matrix salvate ---
loso_m <- bind_rows(lapply(names(confusion_matrices_loso), function(nm) {
  cm <- confusion_matrices_loso[[nm]]
  data.frame(model = sub("_subj.*$", "", nm),
             unit  = sub("^.*_subj", "", nm),
             kappa = if (is.null(cm)) NA_real_ else unname(cm$overall["Kappa"]),
             macro_f1 = if (is.null(cm)) NA_real_ else mean(cm$byClass[, "F1"], na.rm = TRUE))
})) %>% filter(!unit %in% exclude_subjects)

# --- Pooled 10-fold: una riga per (modello, fold) ---
pooled_m <- pooled_pred_df %>%
  group_by(model, unit = as.character(fold)) %>%
  group_modify(~ metrics_from_pred(.x$pred, .x$truth)) %>%
  ungroup()

# --- Within-subject 10-fold: una riga per (modello, soggetto), con le predizioni di tutti i suoi fold ---
within_m <- within_pred_df %>%
  filter(!subject %in% exclude_subjects) %>%
  group_by(model, unit = as.character(subject)) %>%
  group_modify(~ metrics_from_pred(.x$pred, .x$truth)) %>%
  ungroup()

# --- tabelle riassuntive ---
summarise_cv <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    mutate(model = factor(model, levels = model_levels)) %>%
    group_by(model) %>%
    summarise(n = sum(!is.na(kappa)),
              kappa_mean = mean(kappa, na.rm = TRUE),
              kappa_sd = sd(kappa, na.rm = TRUE),
              kappa_median = median(kappa, na.rm = TRUE),
              f1_mean = mean(macro_f1, na.rm = TRUE),
              f1_sd = sd(macro_f1, na.rm = TRUE),
              f1_median = median(macro_f1, na.rm = TRUE),
              .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(across(where(is.numeric) & !n, ~ round(.x, 4)))
}

cat("\n===== Pooled 10-fold (unita' = fold) =====\n");          print(summarise_cv(pooled_m), n = Inf)
cat("\n===== LOSO (unita' = soggetto) =====\n");                print(summarise_cv(loso_m), n = Inf)
cat("\n===== Within-subject 10-fold (unita' = soggetto) =====\n"); print(summarise_cv(within_m), n = Inf)

# tutto in un csv
write.csv(bind_rows(mutate(summarise_cv(pooled_m), cv = "Pooled 10-fold"),
                    mutate(summarise_cv(loso_m),   cv = "LOSO"),
                    mutate(summarise_cv(within_m), cv = "Within-subject 10-fold")),
          "kappa_f1_summary.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r, fig.width=12, fig.height=6}
# ---------- NUOVO: RIEPILOGO E FIGURE (Pooled 10-fold vs LOSO vs Within-subject 10-fold) ----------
# Richiede: results_loso (blocco LOSO), pooled_res e within_res (blocchi sopra).
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
dir.create("figures", showWarnings = FALSE)

model_levels <- c("FNN", "XGBoost", "RandomForest", "KNN", "SVM_radial", "SVM_linear")
cv_levels <- c("Pooled 10-fold", "LOSO", "Within-subject 10-fold")

# unita' di analisi: pooled = fold (10 punti), LOSO = soggetto (30 punti),
# within-subject = media dei 10 fold di ciascun soggetto (30 punti)
loso_units <- results_loso %>%
  transmute(cv = "LOSO", subject = as.character(subject), unit = as.character(subject),
            model, accuracy, training_time_sec)

pooled_units <- pooled_res %>%
  transmute(cv, subject = NA_character_, unit = paste0("fold", fold),
            model, accuracy, training_time_sec)

within_units <- within_res %>%
  group_by(cv, subject, model) %>%
  summarise(accuracy = mean(accuracy, na.rm = TRUE),
            training_time_sec = mean(training_time_sec, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(unit = subject)

unit_df <- bind_rows(loso_units, pooled_units, within_units) %>%
  mutate(model = factor(model, levels = model_levels),
         cv = factor(cv, levels = cv_levels))

summary_all <- unit_df %>%
  group_by(cv, model) %>%
  summarise(n_units = n(),
            mean_accuracy = mean(accuracy, na.rm = TRUE),
            sd_accuracy = sd(accuracy, na.rm = TRUE),
            mean_fit_time_sec = mean(training_time_sec, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop")

print(summary_all, n = Inf)
write.csv(summary_all, "figures/summary_all_cv.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# --- Fig 1: distribuzione dell'accuratezza per modello e tipo di CV ---
p1 <- ggplot(unit_df, aes(model, accuracy, fill = cv)) +
  geom_boxplot(position = position_dodge(0.8), width = 0.7, outlier.size = 0.8) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point", shape = 23, size = 2, fill = "white",
               position = position_dodge(0.8)) +
  labs(title = "Accuratezza per modello e tipo di cross-validation",
       subtitle = "Pooled: 10 fold | LOSO: 30 soggetti | Within-subject: media dei 10 fold per soggetto (rombo = media)",
       x = NULL, y = "Accuracy", fill = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1))
ggsave("figures/fig1_accuracy_boxplot.png", p1, width = 11, height = 6, dpi = 150)
print(p1)

# --- Fig 2: media +- sd ---
p2 <- ggplot(summary_all, aes(model, mean_accuracy, fill = cv)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(0.8), width = 0.7) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_accuracy - sd_accuracy, ymax = mean_accuracy + sd_accuracy),
                position = position_dodge(0.8), width = 0.25) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(max(0, floor(min(summary_all$mean_accuracy - summary_all$sd_accuracy, na.rm = TRUE) * 20) / 20), 1)) +
  labs(title = "Accuratezza media +- sd", x = NULL, y = "Accuracy", fill = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1))
ggsave("figures/fig2_accuracy_mean_sd.png", p2, width = 11, height = 6, dpi = 150)
print(p2)

# --- Fig 3: tempo medio per singolo fit ---
p3 <- ggplot(summary_all, aes(model, mean_fit_time_sec, fill = cv)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(0.8), width = 0.7) +
  scale_y_log10() +
  labs(title = "Tempo medio per singolo fit (scala log)",
       subtitle = "KNN: tempo di predizione (lazy learner)",
       x = NULL, y = "secondi", fill = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1))
ggsave("figures/fig3_fit_time.png", p3, width = 11, height = 6, dpi = 150)
print(p3)

# --- Fig 4: LOSO vs within-subject, soggetto per soggetto ---
sc <- inner_join(
  loso_units %>% select(subject, model, loso = accuracy),
  within_units %>% select(subject, model, within = accuracy),
  by = c("subject", "model")
) %>% mutate(model = factor(model, levels = model_levels))

p4 <- ggplot(sc, aes(loso, within)) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey40") +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7) +
  facet_wrap(~ model, nrow = 2) +
  labs(title = "Per ogni soggetto: LOSO vs within-subject",
       subtitle = "Sopra la diagonale = il modello va meglio quando ha visto dati dello stesso soggetto",
       x = "Accuracy LOSO", y = "Accuracy within-subject (media 10 fold)") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)
ggsave("figures/fig4_loso_vs_within.png", p4, width = 11, height = 6, dpi = 150)
print(p4)
```

```{r, fig.width=18, fig.height=7}
# --- Fig 5: matrici di confusione normalizzate per riga (pooled e within-subject) ---
cm_df <- bind_rows(pooled_pred_df, within_pred_df) %>%
  filter(!is.na(pred)) %>%
  mutate(model = factor(model, levels = model_levels),
         cv = factor(cv, levels = cv_levels)) %>%
  count(cv, model, truth, pred) %>%
  group_by(cv, model, truth) %>%
  mutate(p = n / sum(n)) %>%
  ungroup()

p5 <- ggplot(cm_df, aes(pred, truth, fill = p)) +
  geom_tile(colour = "white") +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(100 * p)), size = 3) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "steelblue", limits = c(0, 1), name = "quota\ndi riga") +
  scale_y_discrete(limits = rev) +
  facet_grid(cv ~ model) +
  labs(title = "Matrici di confusione (% per classe vera)", x = "Predetta", y = "Vera") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11)
ggsave("figures/fig5_confusion_matrices.png", p5, width = 18, height = 7, dpi = 150)
print(p5)
```
